scope: Atlas-tools MCP, task-kernel facade, TRACE surface, and OpenSpec alignment

ownership.taskKernel: available for constrained clients; disabled in OpenCode to avoid context duplication

createdWiredProven.parentAtlasAgenticRepairIntegration: PARTIAL; downstream candidate/revision/authorization gates remain open

gaps.finding: build_agentic_rag_context caps card count and prompt excerpts, but returned card objects and low-level graph tool arrays do not have a shared byte/field budget
gaps.risk: context stuffing and unstable agent prompts
gaps.safeChange: add a bounded response envelope and truncation receipt without changing ranking or source ownership

gaps.finding: find_dependencies, trace_database, trace_tool_chain, find_source_refs, find_feature, and find_route return diagnostic results without a uniform graph/source revision and evidenceRefs envelope
gaps.risk: agent may treat a projection result as current canonical evidence
gaps.safeChange: add optional provenance metadata; preserve existing result arrays

gaps.finding: record_outcome writes a local NDJSON ledger and may create Neo4j relationships; the tool is exposed beside read-only tools
gaps.risk: implicit mutation during agentic repair loops
gaps.safeChange: require explicit authorization and return writesPerformed plus target receipts

gaps.finding: the static MCP parity audit reports seven duplicate names across mcp-server.ts and trace-mcp-server.ts and handler-only names in mcp-server.ts
gaps.risk: client-dependent tool authority and ambiguous routing
gaps.safeChange: classify canonical, compatibility, and trace-only names before renaming anything

gaps.finding: Atlas-tools context selection reads the ACE packet and uses keyword overlap; it does not require a workspace/candidate/manifest revision tuple
gaps.risk: stale context can be presented as current repair evidence
gaps.safeChange: reject stale or revisionless packets at the context boundary; do not create a second cache

alignedOpenSpecFollowUps: parent-atlas-agentic-repair-bundle-integration: MCP top-K tool retrieval remains open
parent-atlas-neural-prefill-encoder: MCP-FILE-TOPK-01 through 10 remain bounded follow-ons
parent-atlas-ace-rlm-bitfrost-integration: ACE/Valkey context and mutation boundaries remain separate
parent-atlas-retrieval-lineage-dag-convergence: revision-qualified candidate and evidence authority remains upstream
